verdict.rationale: Factory supports diff review and merge workflows (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-18, factory-docs-19) and isolates sessions in worktrees, but there is no evidence of automation versioning (e.g., versioned Skills/Missions/Custom Droids), a rollback mechanism for automations, or history/audit trail of automation changes. missing for 10: explicit versioning of automations/skills, rollback/undo capability for executed automations, changelog or diff history across automation revisions, independent confirmation of these features.
